# Render Classification Docs
[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)
| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `docs.classification.render.workflow` |
| Source | `06_workflows/docs.classification.render.workflow.yaml` |
| Tags | documentation, workflow, classification |
Renders `classification_audit.md` and `classification_remediation_workflow.md`
from their static template definitions into `output_dir`. The templates are
the source of truth; `--mode=check` detects drift in the committed `.md`
files so manual edits don't silently overwrite the canonical content.
